title: User Access Audit
description: Review who can log in and what they can do — roles, inactive accounts, and two-factor authentication.

steps.title: List All User Accounts
steps.instructions: Export or review every user in Users → All Users. Note role, last login if available, and business justification.

steps.title: Remove Inactive or Unknown Accounts
steps.instructions: Delete or downgrade accounts for former staff, contractors, and demo users no longer needed.

steps.title: Limit Administrator Roles
steps.instructions: Reserve Administrator for owners and trusted leads. Give editors/authors the minimum role they need.

steps.title: Enforce Strong Passwords
steps.instructions: Require strong passwords for all accounts. Reset weak or shared passwords—especially on administrator accounts.

steps.title: Enable Two-Factor Authentication
steps.instructions: Install a 2FA plugin and require it for Administrator and Editor roles at minimum.

steps.title: Audit Application Passwords
steps.instructions: Review Application Passwords under each user profile. Revoke tokens for retired integrations or old API connections.

steps.title: Document Who Has Access
steps.instructions: Maintain a simple access register: name, role, purpose, and review date. Share with the site owner.
